sales_tax: VAT in Germany is normally 19% of the taxable amount. However, there is a reduction to 7% for certain transactions listed in Annex 2. This reduction applies, among other things, to Supplies, imports and intra-Community acquisitions of certain goods (Appendix 2, numbers 1 to 54). Hire of certain goods (Annex 2, numbers 1 to 54). Rearing and keeping of livestock, cultivation of plants. Services in connection with animal breeding, artificial insemination and animal breeding performance tests. Admission to theaters, concerts, museums and similar cultural performances. Provision of films for exploitation and screening. Granting, transfer and management of copyrights. Circus performances, showman services and turnover from the operation of zoological gardens. Services provided by non-profit, charitable or ecclesiastical organizations. Transportation of persons in various means of transport. Letting of living and sleeping quarters and short-term letting of camping sites. Import of certain goods. Supplies and intra-Community acquisitions of certain goods. Supply of certain products in electronic form. Restaurant and catering services (after 30.05.2020 and before 01.01.2024). The tax is further reduced to 0% for certain transactions, such as the supply of solar modules for photovoltaic systems and the intra-Community acquisition of these modules. || Appendix 2: 1. live animals, 2. meat and meat offal, 3. fish, crustaceans, molluscs, 4. milk, milk products; birds' eggs, egg yolks, honey, 5. other products of animal origin, 6. bulbs, bulbs, tubers, roots, 7. other live plants, mushroom mycelium, 8. flowers, blossoms, buds, 9. foliage, leaves, twigs, parts of plants, 10. vegetables, plants, roots, tubers, 11. edible fruit and nuts, 12. coffee, tea, mate, 13. cereals, 13.
